plan.title: Cancel Recreate Order on Awarded Event

steps.note: Open the already-awarded event supplied by the prepared state.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the test tenant.
Open the RFQ stage named in the case.
Open the RFQ Responses tab before accessing Settings.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Cancel the Recreate Order operation as required by the case.
Verify that cancelling closes the Recreate Order window.
Verify that the awarded event still shows its existing single vendor response.
Verify that the existing vendor remains present after cancellation.
Verify that the existing bid price remains present after cancellation.
Confirm the event page has no rendering or server errors after cancelling.
